D: Neo, Morpheus and Trinity race to find the Keymaker before the machines reach Zion.

S: set down at the Merovingian's table before he starts talking

Bring 125ml water, 60g butter and half a tsp salt to the boil, tip in 75g plain flour and beat over the heat for 2 minutes until it pulls away from the pan. Cool for 5 minutes, then beat in 2 eggs one at a time, 60g grated gruyère, a pinch of nutmeg and pepper. Spoon 20 small mounds onto lined trays, top with another 20g gruyère and bake at 200C for 25 minutes until puffed and deep golden.
Zion temple flatbreads with smoked eggplant
fuel for the whole city dancing in the cave

Char 2 large eggplants over a gas flame or under a hot grill for 20 minutes, turning, until collapsed and smoky. Cover in a bowl for 10 minutes, peel and chop the flesh. Mash with 3 tbsp tahini, the juice of a lemon, a crushed garlic clove, 2 tbsp olive oil and salt. Warm 4 flatbreads in a dry pan and brush with oil. Finish the dip with more oil, smoked paprika and parsley and serve with the torn bread.
M: from the Merovingian's kitchen, slow cooked and very French

Season 8 skin-on chicken thigh cutlets and brown in a tbsp of oil in a heavy casserole, then set aside. Fry 150g bacon lardons until crisp, add 30g butter, 12 peeled pickling onions and 300g button mushrooms and colour for 8 minutes, then 2 garlic cloves. Stir in 2 tbsp flour and 1 tbsp tomato paste, pour in 500ml red wine and 250ml chicken stock, add thyme and 2 bay leaves, return the chicken and simmer covered for 35 minutes, then 10 minutes uncovered. Mash 1kg boiled potatoes with 60g butter and 100ml warm milk and serve with the chicken and parsley.
Potatoes baked slow in cream and garlic. Cause and effect
Thin potato slices baked slowly in garlic cream with nutmeg until soft inside and golden on top.
W: one slice, sent across the room with a little extra code in it

Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk 4 eggs and 150g caster sugar until pale and thick, fold in the chocolate, then 50g almond meal, 30g plain flour, 2 tbsp cocoa and a pinch of salt. Bake in a lined 20cm tin at 170C for 30 minutes until just set and cool for an hour. Pour 100ml hot cream over 100g chopped dark chocolate, stir until glossy, pour over the cake and let it set before slicing.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake up to 1 day ahead and recrisp at 180C for 5 minutes, or freeze the raw mounds and bake from frozen

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C, line 2 trays and grate the gruyère.
Bring the water, butter and salt to the boil. Tip in the flour all at once and beat over the heat for 2 minutes until the dough pulls away from the pan.
Tip into a bowl and cool for 5 minutes.
Beat in the eggs one at a time until glossy, then 60g of the gruyère, the nutmeg and pepper.
Spoon or pipe 20 walnut-sized mounds onto the trays and top with the rest of the cheese.
Bake for 25 minutes until puffed and deep golden, without opening the oven for the first 15.
Serve warm.

dishes.n: Zion temple flatbreads with smoked eggplant
dishes.make_ahead: Make the dip up to 2 days ahead and keep chilled; warm the flatbreads just before serving

steps.text: Char the eggplants over a gas flame or under a very hot grill, turning, until black and collapsed.
Put them in a bowl, cover with a plate and steam for 10 minutes.
Peel off the skin, chop the flesh and drain in a sieve.
Mash with the tahini, lemon juice, garlic, 2 tbsp of the oil and salt to taste.
Warm the flatbreads in a hot dry pan and brush with 1 tbsp of the oil.
Spoon the dip into a bowl, drizzle with the last of the oil, dust with smoked paprika and parsley and serve with the torn bread.

dishes.make_ahead: Braise up to 2 days ahead and keep chilled, it only gets better; reheat gently and make the mash on the night

steps.text: Season the chicken and brown it skin side down in the oil in a large heavy casserole, in batches, then turn and brown the other side. Set aside.
Fry the bacon in the same pot until crisp, then add the butter, onions and mushrooms and colour for 8 minutes. Add the garlic for the last minute.
Stir in the flour and tomato paste for a minute, then pour in the wine and stock, scraping the base. Add the thyme and bay.
Return the chicken skin side up, cover and simmer gently for 35 minutes, then uncover and simmer 10 minutes more to reduce the sauce.
Meanwhile peel and chop the potatoes, boil until tender, drain and mash with the butter and warm milk, seasoning with salt.
Taste the sauce, season, scatter with parsley and serve over the mash.

steps.text: Brown the sliced mushrooms in the oil in a large heavy casserole, in batches, until well coloured. Set aside.
Add the butter, onions, carrots and button mushrooms and colour for 8 minutes. Add the garlic and smoked paprika for the last minute.
Stir in the flour and tomato paste for a minute, then pour in the wine, stock and soy sauce, scraping the base. Add the thyme and bay.
Return the browned mushrooms, cover and simmer gently for 25 minutes, then uncover and simmer 10 minutes more to reduce the sauce.
Meanwhile peel and chop the potatoes, boil until tender, drain and mash with the butter and warm milk, seasoning with salt.
Taste the sauce, season with salt and pepper, scatter with parsley and serve over the mash.

steps.text: Slice the potatoes thin and butter a baking dish.
Warm the cream and milk with the garlic, nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Layer the potatoes in the dish and pour the cream over.
Bake at 170C until tender all the way through and golden.

ingredients.item: dark chocolate, chopped, for the cake
dark chocolate, chopped, for the ganache

steps.text: Heat the oven to 170C and grease and line a 20cm round tin.
Melt the chocolate for the cake with the butter in a bowl over simmering water, stirring until smooth.
Whisk the eggs and sugar until pale and thick.
Fold in the chocolate, then the almond meal, flour, cocoa and salt.
Bake for 30 minutes until just set with a slight wobble in the middle.
Cool completely in the tin.
Bring the cream to a simmer, pour over the ganache chocolate, stand 2 minutes and stir until glossy. Pour over the cake and leave to set.
Slice with a hot knife.
